snippet.title: Assassin's Creed Liberation Remastered Full Game Walkthrough - No Commentary (Complete Story)
snippet.description:
Showcasing Assassin's Creed Liberation Full Walkthrough Guide Including Full Ending Played on PS4 PRO.
All AC Games Playlist - https://goo.gl/2cHk5Z

Consider Hitting that Like Button, If you Enjoyed. It Helps This Channel Grow.

Assassin's Creed Liberation is a 2012 action-adventure video game developed and published by Ubisoft. The plot is set within a fictional history of real-world events and follows the centuries-old struggle between the Assassins, who fight for peace with free will, and the Templars, who desire peace through control. The game is set between 1765 and 1777, and focuses on the life of African-French Assassin Aveline de Grandpré, the series' first female protagonist, as she attempts to stop the Templars gaining control over 18th century New Orleans towards the end of the French and Indian War, which culminates in her seeking out and eliminating the mysterious leader of the group in their operations. The game takes place within an open world and is presented from the third-person perspective with a primary focus on using combat and stealth abilities to complete missions and optional tasks. Liberation received mixed to positive reviews following its release.
